title: Private Pearl Harbor & North Shore tour (Se habla Español)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: USS Arizona Memorial tickets are subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We are excited to offer a day full of diverse activities that will give you a glimpse of the natural beauty of Oahu. You will start the day with a very historical and solemn site, will taste some local coffee, tour the pineapple garden, look for some turtles, eat at a famous food truck park, and more! We can’t wait to have you on board and share this beautiful day with you!
